name: doc-executive-summary
description: Writes an executive summary for the top of any long doc, with the answer in one line, three supporting points and the ask, under 120 words and counted. Use for "run doc-executive-summary", "write an exec summary", "bottom line up front", "summarise this for leadership", "TL;DR for my boss", "my doc buries the answer", "put the ask on top", part of the Claude Docs for Product Managers Pack by 90n.
